title: MGD Version File
description: Single source of truth for a project's version number and release status. Other files are synchronized from it.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. MAJOR = release line, MINOR = new features, PATCH = patches and updates of existing features.

sync_targets.description: Files updated by `mgd-platform version --sync`. Supported: VERSION, package.json, composer.json, template.json.
